text:
Maya: Quick capture from Post-Onboard check with NorthBay (renewal in ~6w). Ran through enablement — they surfaced 6 asks and 2 friction items. Posting raw notes so we can triage into product intake.

Sam: Thanks — can you paste the asks here? I can tag them in the intake board and add customer context.

Maya: Sure — raw list below (copied from meeting notes):
```
1) Per-route cost breakdown in Console (they need per-route daily spend).
2) Admin role scoping: allow team leads to see only their routes.
3) Live prompt examples / templating for new agents.
4) Webhook retry diagnostics (they get 5xx, no visibility why).
5) Better CSV export for usage (include model, tokens, route metadata).
6) Option to pin model variants per-route (not org-wide).

Friction A: Onboarding docs assumed dev team — account managers need a non-dev checklist.
Friction B: They hit a throttling spike during demo (no clear alerting).
```

Ava: Helpful — couple quick Qs: which of these are blocking their rollout vs nice-to-have? Any indication of revenue impact?

Maya: Blocking = 1 (per-route cost) and 4 (webhook retries) — both prevent them from trusting production.
Revenue impact: if blocking not fixed before renewal, likely to slip to expansion hold (they mentioned ~$15k ARR at risk).

Jordi: For webhook retries: do we have request IDs or logs from their hits? If they can share a sample time window we can trace.

Maya: I'll ask them for a 10-minute window tomorrow. They already shared one log snippet — attaching below.

Sam: Let's standardize capture into the intake matrix before moving to product: columns we need = ask_title, one_line_customer_need, impact(P0/P1/P2), customer_quote, severity, contact, ETA preference. I can paste a CSV template here.

Maya: Please — that'll make handoff cleaner.

Sam: CSV snippet: 
```
ask_title,one_line_customer_need,impact,customer_quote,severity,contact,eta_preference
Per-route cost visibility,See daily per-route spend in console,P0,"We can't show finance a single dashboard",high,maya@redwood-cs,6w
Webhook retry diagnostics,Show request-level retry causes,P0,"We see 5xx with no trace",high,maya@redwood-cs,2w
Admin role scoping,Limit admin visibility to team routes,P1,"Ops only wants their routes",medium,maya@redwood-cs,8w
Live prompt templates,Provide example templates in-console,P2,"New agents keep asking for examples",low,maya@redwood-cs,quarterly
CSV export enhancements,Include model+route metadata in export,P1,"Need attribution for billing",medium,maya@redwood-cs,6w
Pin model per-route,Allow route-level model variant pinning,P2,"We want dev+prod variants per route",low,maya@redwood-cs,quarterly
```

Ava: Love the structure. Can you also add a quick "prod_risk" column (yes/no) for things that could block renewal?

Sam: Will do.

feedback-bot: export_ready - /exports/1716004321-northbay-cs-intake.csv

Maya: Thanks team. Plan: I will ask for the 10-min webhook window and confirm the finance contact. Sam — can you drop the updated CSV with prod_risk flagged and move items into the intake board? I'll annotate customer quotes.

Sam: Yup, will update now and tag @Ava + engineering for the P0s. :thumbsup:

Ava: I'll slot a 15-min sync for Tues to quick-review priorities with Eng.

Maya: Perfect — appreciate the quick triage.
